evidence.result: GATE PROVED: first-run guidance controls are live and derivation is evidence-backed (exit 0). Falsified: with NextActionCard reverted to the pre-fix <div>, the same gate printed GATE BROKEN and exited 1; restored, exit 0.

done_when: Find solution for first-time brand/creator users being confused on arrival at the dashboard, and build L0 (dead onboarding controls) + L1 (first-run checklist on both dashboards)
not_checked: whether the checklist actually reduces first-run confusion — that is a claim about users, and no activation funnel is instrumented to test it

whether Tejas's and Swapnil's specific confusion was the empty dashboard rather than an earlier step (signup, KYC, wallet funding) — the root causes explain the reported symptom but were never confirmed against those two sessions
the happy path against a real Spring backend — the browser verification stubbed the API envelope, since localhost:8080 was not running
L2 (in-app how-it-works routes) and L3 (video embed) were not built, so the canonical six-step flow is still unreachable from inside the authenticated shell except via /brand/help

skipped.reason: session policy forbids dispatching a subagent unless the user asks for one, so no independent model reviewed the design. Substituted with a deterministic oracle instead of a model reviewer: gate .proof-os/gates/F-0341-first-run-guidance.sh, falsified against the pre-fix tree (exit 1 on the inert <div>, exit 0 restored) so it is not a gate that greens its own producer's work.
